OCXViewer — a viewer/validator for OCX (.3docx/.ocx) files.

Portable ZIP
  Unzip and run OCXViewer\OCXViewer.exe. No separate Java installation is
  required — a private Java runtime is bundled under OCXViewer\runtime.

MSI installer
  Run the installer, then launch OCXViewer from the Start menu.

Logging
  A default log configuration is built in. To override it, start the app from a
  command prompt:  OCXViewer.exe --log <path-to-your-log4j2.xml>
